options.why: The new b has already been consumed; count must include it and start at 1.
A different character cannot extend the a run. The completed a run must be emitted.
This begins the new run correctly but discards the completed a3 token.
Emit the completed old run, then retain the current character as the first member of the new run.

items.explanation: Emit the completed old run, then retain the current character as the first member of the new run.
